description: Dots and Boxes on a 5×5 dot grid — claim edges, complete boxes, and outsmart the greedy computer.

faqs.a: Yes. Completing a box scores a point and gives you another turn immediately — chain reactions can swing the whole game.
faqs.q: Do I get another turn after completing a box?

faqs.a: The computer first grabs any edge that completes a box for itself, then avoids handing you a free box when it can, and otherwise picks randomly.
There are 16 boxes. With an even count a draw is possible — and common against the computer.
faqs.q: Can it end in a draw?

howto: Pick “Vs computer” or “Two players” and press New game.
Click any unclaimed edge between two dots to draw your line.
Finish a box to score a point — and take another turn.
Most boxes when all 16 are claimed wins.
title: Dots and Boxes
